text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌۭ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱعْبُدُونِ

words.gloss_range: direct vocative address that opens the ayah by summoning the addressees before the premise and command
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) makes the ayah begin as direct summons rather than detached narration. It establishes the caller-called relation before the assertion about the earth and before the worship command, so the reader crosses from the previous punishment scene into immediate divine address.

topics.headline: vocative particle governs the summoned audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's first move is grammatical summoning, not information or command.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the following servant noun as the vocative dependent, and the later premise and command follow inside that address frame.

topics.headline: direct address after the punishment scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from observed punishment into direct speech to believing servants.
topics.reason: The vocative opens a new discourse frame, and the repeated first-person markers across the ayah support immediate divine address.

topics.headline: call particle creates address-immediacy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the call form making distant addressees immediately reachable within divine speech.
topics.reason: The vocative force is secure, while the distance-collapse language should be kept as rhetorical address effect rather than a separate lexical claim.

words.gloss_range: My devoted servants as a plural vocative group; relational belonging is active before the later command to worship
words.root_gloss_range: servanthood, devotional worship or obedience, owned-slave language, and some nonlocal physical or emotional branches; this word selects creaturely and devotional servanthood under divine possession
words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادِيَ}} ({{tr:ʿibādiya}}) names the addressees as possessed by the divine speaker before it asks them to act. The plural servant-name is not generic humanity or a merely social slave class; it is the believing servant group summoned into devotional belonging, and the later plural imperative distributes the obligation across that group. The road-smoothing branch gives a narrowed route pressure beside the wide-earth setting: servant identity can be lived as traversable worship, while the local noun still means My servants. The address also belongs to the spacious-earth migration formula (39:10) and to same-surah worship contrasts (29:17; 29:36). The root ring matters: servant identity opens the ayah, worshipful service closes it, and the repeated servant-root sound makes the shift from constricted punishment to intimate summons audible.

topics.headline: possessed servants are the summoned audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command addresses people already claimed as the speaker's servants.
topics.reason: The noun is vocative, plural, and first-person possessed, so relational belonging is established before the premise and imperative.

topics.headline: servant plural leans toward devotional belonging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees as God's devoted servants rather than a merely social slave class.
topics.reason: V4 separates owned-slave language from creaturely servanthood to God; the first-person divine possession and vocative setting select the devotional-servanthood branch while the plural contrast remains lexical pressure.

topics.headline: servant identity opens the worship ring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah turns named servant identity into commanded worship rather than introducing a separate final topic.
topics.reason: The same root appears in the opening noun and closing imperative, with the earth-premise between them.

topics.headline: road-smoothing image gives route pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices servant identity as something that can be lived out through traversable worship in God's wide earth.
topics.reason: The road-smoothing branch is real but construction-bound; here it survives only as image-pressure beside the spacious-earth setting, not as the selected sense of the servant noun.

topics.headline: formulaic and same-surah worship links
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the address as part of a wider migration and worship pattern, especially the spacious-earth formula (39:10) and same-surah worship contrasts (29:17; 29:36).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels and contrasts; they illuminate formula and register without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: boundary contrast and audible root frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from constricted punishment to intimate summons, with the repeated servant-root sound helping frame that turn.
topics.reason: The boundary rows and sound row both reinforce the same transition from prior punishment to the present servant address.

words.gloss_range: restrictive masculine plural relative pronoun that qualifies the summoned servants as the ones who have believed
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) narrows the vocative. The address is affectionate and direct, but this masculine plural relative pronoun prevents it from becoming unlimited: the servants in view are the rational plural group matched by the following plural belief verb. That completed-belief qualification is finished before the earth-premise begins, separating this protected audience from the punished group of the previous scene.

topics.headline: relative pronoun restricts the address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine summons is narrowed to the believing subset before the premise is stated.
topics.reason: The relative clause is strongly licensed as a qualifier of the vocative servant noun.

topics.headline: plural form ties qualifier to a rational group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the qualifier as a group marker matching the plural believer verb, not an abstract label.
topics.reason: The masculine plural relative is followed by a third-person masculine plural perfect verb.

topics.headline: qualification finishes before the premise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines the protected audience before announcing that God's earth is wide.
topics.reason: The relative clause precedes the assertive premise and separates this believing audience from the prior punishment scene.

words.gloss_range: completed collective belief/trust used as the defining qualifier of the addressed servants
words.root_gloss_range: belief, trust, and security/safety belong to the root family; this Form IV perfect locally selects entering or holding faith as a settled group identity
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) makes belief the settled qualifier of the summoned servants. The perfect plural does not merely report a past episode; it identifies the group that receives the spacious-earth premise and contrasts with unstable claimed belief elsewhere in the surah (29:10). The root's trust and security field remains relevant: faith is heard as an entered trust-state that fits outward room for worship, but it must be heard through the local Form IV faith verb rather than as a free claim that physical safety is already complete.

topics.headline: perfect verb makes belief a settled qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees are already defined by belief before being commanded.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect verb sits inside the relative clause that qualifies the vocative group.

topics.headline: faith carries trust and security pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith as a trust-bearing state that fits the move toward God's spacious provision.
topics.reason: No V4 root guardrail is available for this root, so the trust-security family survives as lexical pressure, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as the faith verb.

topics.headline: Form IV marks active faith commitment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices belief as an entered commitment, not a passive condition.
topics.reason: The Form IV label supports the commitment frame, but the stronger claim of self-caused safety is narrowed because the local verb simply qualifies the believing group.

topics.headline: same-surah faith contrast stabilizes the address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this settled belief contrasts with unstable or claimed belief elsewhere in the surah (29:10).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah contrast can be retained as a lexical and discourse echo without changing the local parse.

topics.headline: faith joins the spacious-earth logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the faith qualifier prepares for the earth premise as worship-capacity rather than mere geography.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and sequence support faith-to-space pressure, while any implied migration step remains contextual rather than a syntactically explicit ellipsis.

words.gloss_range: emphatic introducer of a nominal premise that grounds the result-command
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the middle of the ayah into an asserted premise: God's earth is wide. It governs the subject-predicate architecture and places that assertion between the summons and the command. The migration route may be contextually understood from the spacious-earth formula, but the local syntax gives the explicit bridge through emphatic premise and result, not through a spelled-out omitted command.

topics.headline: emphatic premise grounds the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth's spaciousness as a certified premise for action, not a detached reassurance.
topics.reason: The inna-clause is syntactically forced as the emphatic assertion before the result clause.

topics.headline: case governance separates subject and predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that My earth is the asserted subject and spacious is the predicate carrying the warrant.
topics.reason: The particle governs the earth noun as its ism and the spaciousness predicate as its khabar.

topics.headline: premise hinges address into imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's three-beat movement: address, grounded premise, then exclusive command.
topics.reason: The clause ordering places the emphatic premise between the qualified vocative and the result-command.

topics.headline: spaciousness implies a practical migration route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the spacious-earth premise presses toward practical relocation for exclusive worship, while the syntax itself does not spell out that migration command.
topics.reason: The attachment bundle lists no explicit ellipsis, so the row's omitted migration language is narrowed to contextual implication carried by spacious-earth and result linkage.

words.gloss_range: My earth as concrete land and divine domain, governed as the subject of the emphatic spaciousness premise
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, land, and territory; locally the noun remains concrete terrestrial domain under first-person divine possession
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْضِى}} ({{tr:arḍī}}) is the governed subject of the premise, and its first-person suffix is the point. The ayah does not say only that land exists; it says the land available for worship belongs to the speaker, so physical territory and theological domain stay together without escaping the earthly sense. The singular possessed earth gathers possible places under one divine domain, reversing the prior underfoot enclosure into wide provision. It also intensifies the spacious-earth formula by shifting from reported divine possession to direct My earth (39:10), while same-surah earth language narrows here into first-person possession (29:52).

topics.headline: earth is the governed subject of the assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the premise centers God's earth as the asserted subject before it predicates spaciousness.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative under the emphatic particle as its governed ism.

topics.headline: first-person possession claims the territory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the space offered for worship is not neutral territory but My earth.
topics.reason: The first-person possessive aligns this earth noun with the same divine speaker who owns the servants and receives worship.

topics.headline: earth remains concrete terrestrial room
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the liberation is room in God's land, not escape from earthly obligation.
topics.reason: The root lacks V4 guardrail rows, but local grammar and contextual profiles support concrete earth or land as the selected noun range.

topics.headline: singular earth gathers possible territories
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many possible places gathered under one possessed earth rather than scattered alternatives outside divine claim.
topics.reason: The local noun is feminine singular and concrete, making earth a stable spatial substrate under divine possession.

topics.headline: first-person version of spacious-earth formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the spacious-earth pattern as a migration-capacity formula intensified by direct first-person possession (39:10).
topics.reason: The concrete reference to the known formula is compatible with the local possessed earth noun and its predicate.

topics.headline: underfoot ground becomes wide provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same spatial plane reversed from punishment beneath the feet in the prior ayah to wide divine territory here.
topics.reason: The boundary contrast is a discourse-level payoff attached to the local earth noun and its spaciousness predicate.

topics.headline: same-surah earth language narrows to possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices general same-surah earth language narrowing here into direct divine possession (29:52).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah contrast can be used as recurrence background while the local syntax remains decisive.

words.gloss_range: spacious, ample, and capacity-bearing as the indefinite predicate of God's earth
words.root_gloss_range: spaciousness against constriction, capacity to contain or bear, ample means, and encompassing breadth; locally the active participle predicates usable room of the earth
words.prose: {{ar:وَٰسِعَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:wāsiʿatun}}) predicates open capacity of God's earth. Its indefiniteness leaves the room unboxed, while its feminine agreement keeps the spaciousness attached to the earth rather than floating as a general attribute. As an active participle, it presents available standing capacity, though not personal agency for the earth. The root's breadth and capacity fields make the land not just large but usable for worship beyond constraining places; the spacious-earth recurrence gives this migration-capacity weight (39:10; 4:97). Divine-capacity resonance survives as reflection of encompassing provision, not as a replacement of the literal land premise.

topics.headline: indefinite predicate asserts open capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices spaciousness as the asserted open quality that grounds the command.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative indefinite predicate of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: agreement locks capacity to the earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the capacity belongs to God's earth in this premise, not to an abstract topic.
topics.reason: The feminine singular predicate agrees with the earth noun.

topics.headline: root capacity makes spaciousness usable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth's width as practical capacity for worship beyond constraining places.
topics.reason: V4 supports both spatial breadth and capacity or easing branches; the local predicate selects usable spaciousness.

topics.headline: active participle marks standing capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices spaciousness as an available standing quality, while the form does not require treating the earth as personally agentive.
topics.reason: The active participle supports standing capacity, but the claim that the earth is actively animate or agentive is narrowed.

topics.headline: divine-capacity resonance reflects through creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices physical spaciousness resonating with divine encompassing provision without leaving the land sense.
topics.reason: The broader divine-capacity branch is real for the root, but local grammar predicates spaciousness of the possessed earth.

topics.headline: spacious-earth recurrence carries migration pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as a migration-capacity warrant, especially through the spacious-earth pattern (39:10) and related capacity pressure (4:97).
topics.reason: The local earth-plus-spaciousness premise and supplied recurrence evidence make migration capacity a strong surviving payoff.

words.gloss_range: result/consequence particle that turns the spacious-earth premise toward the fronted exclusive object
words.prose: The first {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge where the premise becomes consequence. Because it attaches before the fronted object, the first visible result of the spacious earth is not the verb but Me alone. This makes exclusivity the practical conclusion of divine spatial provision and starts the two-particle escalation that will resume in the imperative. Against the prior confinement scene, the result feels urgent: the practical route is worship-capable relocation, with migration pressure understood contextually rather than supplied as a separate explicit clause.

topics.headline: result particle turns premise into consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command follows as a consequence of God's spacious earth, not as a loose next item.
topics.reason: The attachment bundle marks the following clause as result linked to the emphatic premise.

topics.headline: consequence lands first on the exclusive object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Me alone as the first expressed consequence before the imperative arrives.
topics.reason: The particle prefixes the detached object, and attachment evidence marks that object as the direct object of the later imperative.

topics.headline: hinge from declaration to command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the stepped movement from established fact to obligation through the two-particle frame.
topics.reason: The first particle starts the result clause and the later particle resumes the imperative, creating a local stepped structure.

topics.headline: result gains urgency from confinement contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the consequence as urgent against the prior confinement scene and as practically oriented toward worship-capable relocation.
topics.reason: The confinement contrast and migration logic survive as contextual pressure, but the attachment evidence does not make a separate migration ellipsis explicit.

words.gloss_range: fronted first-person accusative object, isolating the divine speaker as the exclusive worship target before the verb
words.prose: {{ar:إِيَّٰىَ}} ({{tr:iyyāya}}) pulls the worship object forward and makes the result of the premise visible as Me alone. The later verb must be read through this focus block: worship is not merely commanded, but restricted to the speaking I who has already said My servants and My earth. The echo with the worship formula in 1:5 is useful as a reversed discourse direction, not as a replacement for the local grammar.

topics.headline: first-person pronoun names the exclusive object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same divine I becoming the sole worship target after owning servants and earth.
topics.reason: The detached pronoun is first-person and refers to the divine speaker in the discourse frame.

topics.headline: fronting creates exclusivity before the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the object pulled before the verb so the command cannot be heard as worship plus something else.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the pronoun as the fronted direct object of the later imperative.

topics.headline: detached focus anticipates suffixed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exclusivity first as an independent focus and then as the object inside the command.
topics.reason: The local grammar has both the fronted detached object and a first-person object suffix on the imperative.

topics.headline: worship-pronoun pattern reverses discourse direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a worship-pronoun echo with 1:5, but with God speaking about Himself rather than humans addressing God.
topics.reason: The concrete reference gives an inter-ayah contrast that remains subordinate to the local fronted-object grammar.

topics.headline: three first-person anchors accumulate claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the chain of My servants, My earth, and Me alone as one claim over audience, space, and worship direction.
topics.reason: The three first-person anchors are all locally present and converge in the final worship object.

words.gloss_range: resumptive/explanatory particle that releases the fronted exclusive object into the imperative verb
words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) resumes after the fronted object and turns Me alone into the required act: worship Me. Together, the two particles bracket the ending: first therefore Me alone, then therefore worship Me. The command feels like the unpacking of exclusivity rather than a detached new clause.

topics.headline: resumptive particle turns exclusivity into action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Me alone is immediately explained as worship Me.
topics.reason: After the fronted object, the particle resumes the imperative that supplies the action.

topics.headline: prefix fuses resumption with the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the imperative delivered as the resolution of the suspended object focus.
topics.reason: The particle prefixes the imperative word directly, and the verb resolves the fronted object.

topics.headline: double-particle bracket frames object and command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local cadence separating consequence from verbal execution: first Me alone, then worship Me.
topics.reason: The two particles occur around the fronted object and imperative, creating a compact syntactic frame.

words.gloss_range: plural imperative to worship or serve Me, with the divine object both anticipated by the fronted pronoun and repeated in the suffix
words.root_gloss_range: worship, devotional service, submissive obedience, servant identity, owned-slave language, and other nonlocal branches such as road-smoothing; locally the Form I imperative selects worshipful service to the divine speaker
words.prose: {{ar:ٱعْبُدُونِ}} ({{tr:ʿbudūni}}) completes the ayah by turning servant identity into commanded service. The imperative is plural, so the summoned servants remain a collective audience, while the first-person object keeps the worship target singular and exclusive. The object has already been fronted and is then repeated in the suffix, so the command carries both exclusivity and verbal completion; variant endings affect the final pronominal closure without altering that object relation. Form I keeps the command as immediate worshipful service toward Me, not causing others to serve or describing self-formation. Wider root images such as smoothed route can enrich the movement through God's wide earth, but the local verb selects direct worshipful service. Same-surah worship formulas shift here into direct first-person command (29:17; 29:36), the closing servant-root sound answers the opening servant-name, and the boundary redirects human action from punishable deeds to prescribed worship.

topics.headline: fronted and suffixed object reinforce exclusivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the worship object first as independent focus and again inside the verb, making exclusivity explicit twice.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks both the fronted pronoun and the verbal suffix as first-person objects of the imperative.

topics.headline: imperative turns premise into required worship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from asserted spaciousness into required worshipful action.
topics.reason: The word is a Form I plural imperative in the result clause after the emphatic premise.

topics.headline: worship includes devotional service
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command as directed devotional service, not only ritual performance.
topics.reason: The worship and submissive-obedience branch is locally selected, while the claim of the full semantic spectrum is narrowed to relevant devotional service.

topics.headline: road-smoothing image gives route pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship as a directed path through God's wide earth, while the verb still means worshipful service.
topics.reason: The smoothed-road branch is a real root branch but is construction-bound, so it survives here only as route image beside the spacious-earth premise.

topics.headline: closing command answers opening servant-name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing command as the enacted fulfillment of the servant identity named at the opening.
topics.reason: The same root frames the ayah in the opening servant noun and the closing worship imperative.

topics.headline: Form I keeps the command direct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command as immediate service toward Me, not causing others to serve or describing self-formation.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form I imperative, and no causative or reflexive alternative is locally present.

topics.headline: many servants are bound to one worship target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a plural audience commanded toward one first-person object.
topics.reason: The verb carries second-person masculine plural imperative agreement and a first-person object suffix.

topics.headline: variant endings keep the divine object relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational variation affects final pronominal closure without changing the worship command or divine object relation.
topics.reason: The variant evidence is useful as apparatus for sound and pronoun completion, not as a different local command.

topics.headline: same-surah worship commands culminate in first-person address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from third-person or prophetic worship formulas to direct divine first-person command (29:17; 29:36).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah contrasts sharpen the direct divine speech register without changing the local imperative.

topics.headline: closing sound concentrates the root ring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound movement from the fronted pronoun into the compact imperative and the repeated servant-root frame.
topics.reason: The sound rows reinforce the same semantic ring from servant identity to worship command.

topics.headline: punitive command contrasts prescriptive worship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices human action redirected from punishable deeds in the prior scene to worshipful service here.
topics.reason: The boundary contrast keeps the imperative mood in view while distinguishing punishment-command from prescriptive command.

topics.headline: servant-worship ring frames spacious earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root ring framing the spacious-earth center as the reason servant identity must become worship.
topics.reason: The opening servant noun, central earth premise, and closing worship command are all local and structurally aligned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 5-6 name an expansive earth as the speaker's, while words 1 and 8 pair servant identity with the worship imperative.
baseline_models.mechanism: The whole terrestrial field belongs to one speaker, spatial breadth opens alternatives beyond any obstructive locale, and the repeated servant/worship root keeps allegiance invariant while place can change.

activation_trace.role: The terrestrial lower expanse supplies the literal field whose first-person possession makes every location part of one domain.
Spatial opening supplies room beyond a constricted locale and makes movement thinkable.
The servant noun and worship command bind identity and action as humble obedience across the opened field.

changed_reading.before: The earth is geographically large, followed by a general command to worship.
changed_reading.after: No single locale exhausts the speaker's domain: place may change when it blocks obedience, but exclusive allegiance does not.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal transition from the assertion of breadth at word 6 to the exclusive imperative at words 7-8.
baseline_models.mechanism: Breadth can name usable capacity and practical relief from constriction, so the assertion does more than describe acreage: it answers whether the demanded worship remains feasible and permitted under pressure.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and bearable scope turn physical width into an assurance that obedient action remains within reach.
Practical easing supplies a license-like removal of hardship rather than a merely scenic description.
Submissive worship is the action for which the available room and relief are supplied.

changed_reading.before: Wide means that more land exists.
changed_reading.after: Wide also means that the command is furnished with usable capacity and released from the claim that one constricted setting is unavoidable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressees are characterized by the trust/belief root at word 3 before being told that the earth is expansive.
baseline_models.mechanism: Belief carries both heart-settling trust and assenting confirmation; placed before spatial release, it can make trust the inner condition that permits loosening dependence on one familiar place.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supply the affective stability needed when geography becomes unsettled.
Heart-confirmed belief keeps the address doctrinally anchored rather than reducing it to travel advice.
Opened space is the outward counterpart to inward trust.

changed_reading.before: Those who assent are informed of a large territory.
changed_reading.after: Those whose hearts entrust themselves are invited to release a constricting attachment to place without releasing faith.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person possessives join the servants at word 1 and the earth at word 5 to the same speaker.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ownership image in servant identity and the earth branch that can name a stranger shift belonging away from native soil; the honor branch keeps this claimed status from being only degradation.

activation_trace.role: Being claimed as a servant makes relational ownership portable across locations.
The honor side of the address allows claimed servanthood to carry dignity rather than mere subjection.
The stranger image exposes the social cost of movement while keeping that foreignness inside the speaker's earth.

changed_reading.before: Leaving native land makes a person an unclaimed outsider.
changed_reading.after: A servant may become locally foreign yet remain claimed and honored everywhere within the same speaker's earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first tests professed faith, then depicts harm that makes a person unable to settle, rescue by separation, and an explicit move from one abode to another toward the Lord. These cues turn the focus's breadth from abstract consolation into an actionable exit from coercive conditions.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies spatial room in which departure can occur.
Testing exposes whether voiced belief can survive a costly change in circumstances.
Injury that prevents settled rest supplies the pressure that can make remaining in place untenable.
Rescue pictured as release by separation supplies a precedent for safety through disengagement.
Movement from one abode to another toward the Lord gives the opened space an explicit directional enactment.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 puts the profession of belief under testing before any migration narrative appears.
29:24-26 moves in sequence from threatened burning, through rescue, to an explicit departure toward the Lord.
In 29:56 the result marker connects announced breadth directly to the exclusive worship command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tested belief, destabilizing harm, rescue by separation, and a move between abodes; I infer that obstructed worship is the condition under which breadth authorizes departure, while steadfast endurance in place remains a live alternative when worship is still possible.

changed_reading.before: The focus generally reassures pressured believers that other places exist.
changed_reading.after: The focus makes tested faith mobile: when coercive place and exclusive worship become incompatible, departure within God's domain can itself enact fidelity.

context_deltas.mechanism: False protective attachment is pictured as a structurally weak dwelling, whereas faithful actors are later given settled, elevated rooms. The focus between them makes movement across the broad earth a transfer of reliance and lodging, not simple homelessness.

activation_trace.role: The speaker-owned terrestrial field is the interim space across which shelter can be relinquished and re-situated.
The dwelling and refuge image makes misplaced protective allegiance materially house-like.
Loss of strength reveals that the apparent refuge cannot bear the protective load assigned to it.
Being installed in a prepared abode supplies a positive answer to the fear of displacement.
Elevated chambers replace the fragile local shelter with durable, raised lodging.

structural_cues: The weak-house image of 29:41 precedes the focus, while promised lodging in 29:58 follows it.
29:55 closes space vertically with punishment from above and below; 29:56 opens it horizontally before 29:58 supplies a new abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed refuge and later prepared lodging; I infer that leaving an obstructive shelter is a re-housing of allegiance rather than abandonment to placelessness, while the later rooms may remain solely eschatological rather than a promise of earthly housing.

changed_reading.before: Leaving a familiar place primarily means losing shelter.
changed_reading.after: The focus loosens dependence on a fragile protective house and places the traveler within a larger divine domain oriented toward prepared lodging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is denied to rival objects of worship, assigned by God, shown not to be self-carried by every creature, and expanded or restricted among servants. Patience and reliance connect this economy to movement, so earth's breadth includes livelihood capacity and not only destinations.

activation_trace.role: Breadth of means and livelihood lets the focus's spatial adjective carry an economic dimension.
Apportioned giving is detached from rival worship and attached to the one toward whom worship is directed.
Self-restraint under distress supplies the temporal discipline required before provision is visible.
Reliance supplies the relational posture that prevents livelihood uncertainty from freezing action.
The image of lifting and carrying an outward load exposes the assumption that a mover must transport a complete guarantee of sustenance.
Sustaining food is supplied to creatures and addressees, answering the practical fear beneath departure.
Expansion and increase make provision's breadth an active divine distribution rather than a fixed local resource.
Restriction to a narrow measure prevents the model from promising uniformly abundant outcomes.

structural_cues: 29:17 already joins worship and the ownership of provision.
29:56-62 runs from breadth, through death and promised lodging, to patience, reliance, non-carrying creatures, and expanded or restricted provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies apportioned sustenance, creatures that do not carry it, reliance, and expansion or restriction; I infer that these answer the livelihood fear latent in leaving a place, while they may instead teach reliance under any circumstance and do not guarantee prosperity after movement.

changed_reading.before: A wide earth offers possible destinations but the mover must first secure and carry livelihood independently.
changed_reading.after: The focus's breadth includes divinely apportioned means: obedience need not wait for total self-guarantee, though provision may still arrive in restricted measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A protected enclosure is physically secure while people around it are seized, yet the same verse uses the security/belief root for false allegiance. This distinguishes local safety from faithful trust and prevents the focus's wide earth from being misread as uniformly danger-free.

activation_trace.role: The addressees' settled trust supplies a portable form of security not identical with enclosure.
A bounded sanctuary supplies genuine but geographically concentrated protection.
The paired secure-place and believing uses expose the difference between physical safety and where trust is placed.
Rapid seizure outside the enclosure keeps real travel danger inside the model.
The surrounding zone draws the spatial boundary across which safety is uneven.

structural_cues: 29:67 contrasts a secure center with exposed surroundings, then immediately questions false belief.
The focus addresses believers through the same root before announcing a broad domain rather than a bounded sanctuary.

changed_reading.before: Believers can move because all of God's wide earth should be equally safe.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah denies escape anywhere on earth, shows earth itself engulfing, and places universal death and return immediately after the focus. Breadth is therefore operational room for obedience before return, not unlimited flight from divine reach or mortality.

activation_trace.role: The broad terrestrial field supplies horizontal room, but remains the same earth named in the limits that follow.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies traversal, obstructed roads, corrupt and arrogant land use, truth-grounded creation, and guided paths; I infer a tenant-like ethic under the possessive 'My,' while the plural paths may be primarily moral disciplines rather than literal migration routes.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 5 can carry a branch image of clinging or becoming heavy toward ground, directly opposed by the expansion at word 6.

activation_trace.role: Clinging and heaviness toward ground supply an internal mechanism by which one patch of a broad earth can become immobilizing.

changed_reading.before: Narrowness is only an external shortage of available land.
changed_reading.after: Even a vast earth becomes functionally narrow when one clings to a single ground; the call may release psychic immobilization as well as physical confinement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped target for the breadth root, whose branch names an idol, and must not be presented as etymology or translation. It remains packet-valid because that target is attached to word 6 and the immediate command is exclusive worship amid repeated idol-worship context; render only as a contained sound-and-branch resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant target attached to word 6 places an idol-name branch immediately before the fronted exclusive object and worship command.

activation_trace.role: The idol-name side branch creates a remote anti-idol resonance at the threshold of exclusive worship.
An explicitly worshiped idol supplies the surah-level polemical environment that activates the remote branch.
Repeated worship acts divided between rivals and God make exclusivity, rather than mere spatial size, the functional contrast.

changed_reading.before: The adjective contributes only spatial vastness before the worship command.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory branch level, the sound-field of vastness brushes against a named idol only to be cut off by 'Me alone': no localized cult object can own the wide domain.

strongest_changes: Whole-surah testing, harm, rescue, and explicit migration turn spatial breadth into a practicable response when place obstructs worship.
Weak refuge before the focus and prepared lodging after it recast departure as re-housing allegiance rather than becoming placeless.
Provision, non-carrying creatures, patience, reliance, and measured expansion answer the livelihood fear latent in mobility without promising abundance.
The secure-sanctuary contrast and the immediate death/return sequence bound the reading: broad earth is neither uniformly safe nor an escape from divine reach.
summary.what_was_special: The focus acts as a hinge: vertical enclosure in 29:55 opens into horizontal breadth at 29:56, then closes into death and return before unfolding lodging, reliance, and provision. Repeated servant, belief/security, earth, route, and provision cues make one short command simultaneously spatial, relational, economic, and ethical without collapsing those readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the primary practical scope is literal migration from persecution or any release from conditions that obstruct worship.
How strongly capacity, livelihood, and stranger branches should color the dominant spatial sense of breadth and earth.
The non-dominant idol-name resonance is packet-resolvable but very form-distant and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Spatial room releases exclusive worship.** و س ع B001 is spaciousness against constriction, B005 is easing by making room, and B006 is wide stride or pace. The possessive “my earth” precedes exclusive worship, so geography is offered as room to leave coercive constraint. I infer that movement is an enabling condition when local pressure blocks fidelity; vastness reads as divinely supplied action-space for worship.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:58 supplies lasting chambers after movement, and 29:60 promises provision to creatures that do not carry it. Spaciousness therefore includes both a destination and sustenance along the route.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wide earth supplies room for faithful action without supplying escape from return.** Lexical evidence: `أَرْضِى`, root `ء ر ض`, `B001` (lower ground); `وَاسِعَة`, root `و س ع`, `B001` (spaciousness against constriction); and `ءَامَنُوا`, root `ء م ن`, `B001` (settled security and trust). Structural cue: the ayah follows ruinous enclosure (`29:54-55`) but precedes universal death and return (`29:57`). Assigned role: spaciousness removes local constriction around worship; trust enables movement into that room. Abductive move: I infer a distinction between escaping oppressive locality and escaping final accountability: the first is enabled, the second remains impossible. Reading change: divine spaciousness authorizes relocation rather than passive endurance of every place.

2. **Possessive repetition relocates service under the owner of servant and terrain.** Lexical evidence: `عِبَادِى / فَٱعْبُدُون`, root `ع ب د`, `B003` (worship and submissive obedience), and the first-person possessives in “My servants,” “My earth,” and “Me.” Structural cue: exclusive fronting `فَإِيَّايَ` follows the declaration of broad terrain; `29:59-62` then link reliance, provision, and divine allocation. Assigned role: ownership of persons and space grounds the exclusive claim to service. Abductive move: the packet supplies possessive grammar and later provision; I infer that worship is the stable dependency that can persist across changed locations. Reading change: migration changes place while preserving, and clarifying, the governing relation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:60`, `29:65`):** Moving creatures receive provision they do not carry, and ship passengers are transferred safely to land. These scenes give wide earth a kinetic meaning: spaciousness supports creaturely movement and worshipful relocation under provision, not idle territorial abundance.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nitelenen kişinin saygı gösterilen, yüceltilen ve hizmet edilen biri olduğunu açıkça belirtir. Bu anlam, benzer biçimin ezilmiş veya kullanıma hazırlanmış nesneyi nitelediği daldan karşıt bir değerle ayrılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çekirdeği güç ve sağlamlık olarak verir; dayanıklılık ve kalıcılık bunun zaman içindeki görünümü, dişi devedeki semizlik ise canlıya özgü belirti olarak sunulur. Bunlar kölelik veya boyun eğmeyle ilişkili değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel güç, sağlamlık ve dayanıklılığı anlatır; toplumsal kölelik ya da duygusal öfke anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın güç adı ile deve ve kumaşa bağlı söz öbekleri birlikte bulunur; canlıya özgü semizlik bütün dalın genel anlamı yapılmaz.

facets.statement: Temel nitelik fiziksel güç ve sağlamlıktır.
Kumaş bağlamında güç, kullanıma karşı dayanma ve kalıcılık olarak görünür.
Dişi deve bağlamında güçlü yapıya semizlik de eklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar güç ve sağlamlık çekirdeğinde birleşir; bunu kumaşın dayanması ve dişi devenin güçlü, semiz yapısı üzerinden somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın niteliği, kumaştaki kalıcılığı ve devedeki güçlü yapıyı ortak çekirdekte karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi incinmiş gurur, öfke ve kendini koruma duygusunu merkezde verir; ayrıca keder ve yoğun iç duygulanımı aktarır. Geçici çerçevedeki kaçırılmış şey için pişmanlık ayrıntısı kaynak cümlesinde açık değildir, bu yüzden tanım bu ek koşula bağlanmadan kurulmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal incinmiş gururdan yükselen öfke ile kederli iç duygulanımı kapsar; güç ve sağlamlık anlamından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın duygu adı ile gururu incindiği için susmayı anlatan söz öbeği birlikte bulunur; susma yalnız özel kullanımın sonucudur.

concept_map.definition: İncinmiş gurur ve kendini koruma duygusuyla yükselen öfke ya da içe çöken kederli duygulanımdır; özel kullanımda kişi bu incinme yüzünden susar.

facets.statement: Duygu incinmiş gurur, onurunu koruma isteği ve öfke çevresinde oluşur.
Kaynak ifadesi anlamı keder ve yoğun iç sıkıntısına da uzatır.
Özel söz öbeğinde gururu incinen kişinin tepkisi susmak olur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar incinmiş gurur, öfke ve kendini koruma duygusunu ortak çekirdek yapar; bazı aktarımlar keder ve yoğun iç duygulanımı da aynı ad altında verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı söz öbeğine bağlı anlam verir: bir işi yapmakta gecikmemek ve koşarken bir ölçü hızlanmak. Bunlar tek bir yalın eylem anlamına indirgenemez, fakat dal iki yapı açıkça ayrılarak korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen iki söz öbeğinde gecikmeme veya biraz hızlanma bildirir; genel bir hız kökü gibi yorumlanmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir yerin ya da şeyin dar olmayacak biçimde geniş bulunmasını, geniş duruma gelmesini ve genişletilmesini birlikte anlatır. Oturma yerinde birbirine yer açma örneği de bu uzamsal çekirdeğin uygulamasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal para bolluğunu, bir işi yapabilme gücünü veya hayvanın adım uzunluğunu değil, uzamsal genişliği ve onun değişimini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın uzamsal genişliği, genişleme ve genişletme biçimlerini kapsar; oturma yerinde yer açma ise yalnız bağlı kullanım olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerin ya da şeyin dar olmayacak ölçüde açık ve geniş olması, bu duruma gelmesi veya bu duruma getirilmesidir. İnsanların oturduğu yerde birbirine alan açması bunun bağlama bağlı bir uygulamasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir yer veya şey, darlığın karşıtı olarak yeterince açık ve geniştir.
Şey kendiliğinden geniş duruma gelebilir ya da bir etken tarafından genişletilebilir.
Bir oturma yerinde insanların birbirine yer açması, uzamsal genişletmenin toplumsal bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, darlığın karşısındaki uzamsal açıklığı hem durum hem de genişleme ya da genişletme süreci olarak verir; yer açma kullanımı bu çekirdeği somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Uzamsal durum ile bu duruma geçişi ve bir şeyi bu duruma getirmeyi birlikte anlatan en kapsamlı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Darlığın karşıtı olan durumu, genişlemeyi ve genişletmeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yerin veya şeyin daha geniş duruma geldiği geçişsiz kullanımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Dar olmayan bir duruma doğru gerçekleşen değişimi korur.
error_profile.loses: Durağan genişlik ile bir etkenin yaptığı genişletmeyi tek başına anlatmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların oturduğu bir alanda başkalarının sığabilmesi için aralarını açtıkları bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ortak alanda fiilen daha çok boşluk oluşturma örneğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel uzamsal genişliği ve başka tür genişleme süreçlerini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: genişlemek veya daha çok alan istemek

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği insanın bir işi yapabilme gücü ve bir kabın belirli miktarı alabilme kapasitesidir. Aynı ifadede para gücüne değinen öğeler bulunsa da bunlar ayrı para ve geçim bolluğu dalında tutulmalı; evde kalıp onunla yetinme kalıbı da çekirdeğin özel bir kullanımından öteye genellenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal insanın güç yetirmesi ile kabın alma kapasitesini kapsar; para zenginliğini bağımsız bir ana anlam olarak kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel güç yetirme çekirdeğini korur, kapların alma kapasitesini ayrı bir uzantı olarak gösterir ve kalıplaşmış evde kalma kullanımını genelleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın bir işi yapmaya gücünün yetmesi ya da bir kabın belirli bir miktarı içine alabilmesidir. Kapasite, insan için katlanılabilir iş yüküyle, kap için alabileceği miktarla sınırlanır.

facets.statement: İnsan bakımından anlam, bir işi yapabilecek veya bir yükü taşıyabilecek güce sahip olmaktır.
Kap bakımından anlam, belirli bir miktarı içine alabilecek hacme sahip olmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kaynak ifadesi, kapasiteyi insanın güç yetirebildiği sınır ve kabın içine alabildiği miktar üzerinden kurar; para gücüne değinen ortak öğe ise ayrı bolluk dalıyla sınır paylaşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan için yapılabilir iş sınırını, kap için de içine alınabilir miktar sınırını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanın etkin gücü ile kabın miktar alma sınırını ayrı katılımcılar üzerinden korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın verilen işi yapıp yapamayacağının söz konusu olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin işi yapabilme gücünü ve sınırını doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir kabın belirli miktarı içine alma kapasitesini anlatmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kabın belirli sayı veya ölçüdeki içeriği sığdırdığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın alabileceği miktarla sınırlı fiziksel kapasiteyi korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsanın bir işe güç yetirmesi ve yükü taşıması anlamını anlatmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi para varlığı, ödeme gücü ve geçim bolluğunu açıkça ortak bir kümede toplar; varlıklı duruma gelme ve birini bolluğa çıkarma süreçlerini de içerir. Güç yetirme ile kesişen ölçüsünde harcama kalıbı, burada ancak kişinin maddi varlığı bakımından okunmalı ve genel kapasite anlamına taşırılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal para ve geçim bakımından bolluktur; genel iş yapabilme gücü yalnız harcama ölçüsünü belirlediği yerde sınır teması kurar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım para ve geçim bolluğunu, varlıklı olma durumunu ve bu duruma geçişi ayırır; ölçüsünde harcama kalıbını yalnız maddi bağlamda tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin para, mal ve geçim bakımından bolluk içinde bulunması veya böyle bir bolluğa kavuşmasıdır. Bu durum, harcama ve ödeme yapabilecek maddi güce sahip olmayı da içerir.

facets.statement: Kişi para, mal ve geçim bakımından bolluk ve varlık içindedir.

Bolluk, kişinin harcama ve ödeme yapabilecek maddi güce sahip olmasıyla görünür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'ya özgü bir niteleme içinde bilginin, esirgemenin, gücün, geçim vermenin ve bağışın her şeyi kuşatmasını ortak çekirdek olarak sunar. Bu, insanın para zenginliğinden veya yalnız fiziksel bir yerin genişliğinden farklıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, Tanrı'nın bilgi, esirgeme, güç ve bağış bakımından her şeyi kuşatmasını anlatır; sıradan maddi ya da uzamsal genişlik değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım niteleme biçimi ile bilgi ve esirgeme kalıplarını aynı kuşatma çekirdeğinde tutar, fakat bunları yalın insan zenginliğine genellemez.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'nın bilgisinin, esirgemesinin, gücünün, geçim vermesinin ve bağışının bütün varlıkları kuşatması ve hiçbir şeyi dışarıda bırakmamasıdır. Niteleme, bu alanlardaki kapsam ile bol vermeyi birlikte taşır.

Her şeyi kuşatma anlamına bol ve çok bağışta bulunma niteliği eşlik eder.

Güler yüzle insanları hoşnut etme kalıbı bu genel kolaylaştırıcı tutumun özel bir toplumsal uygulamasıdır; yalın izin veya uzamsal genişlik anlamına çevrilmemelidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin sürüp geçmesi temelini zamanın şimdiki kesiti, gece ve gündüzün bir bölümü ve dünyanın sonundaki diriliş günüyle ilişkilendirir. Bu nedenle geçici çerçeve doğrudur; ancak dal yalnızca soyut zaman akışı değildir ve yapıya bağlı zaman, işlem, kiralama ve güçlük kullanımları ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak zaman anlamları ile belirli söz öbeklerine bağlı anlamlar birlikte bulunduğundan tanım bunları birbirine karıştırmadan ayırır.

Yapıya bağlı kullanımlar gecenin sakinleşmesinden sonraki aralığı, zaman dilimi başına işlem ya da işçi tutmayı ve çetin bir zaman kesitini bildirir.

facets.statement: Anlamın temeli bir şeyin kesintisiz sürmesi ve zaman içinde geçmesidir.
Sözcük şimdiki zamanı veya gece ile gündüzden belirli bir bölümü gösterir.
Dünyanın sona erip insanların yeniden dirileceği gün de bu zaman adıyla belirtilir.
Belirli gece söz öbeklerinde gecenin sakinleşmesinden sonra geçen bir süre anlatılır.
Türemiş kullanımlar bir işlemi veya işçi tutmayı zaman dilimi başına yapmayı anlatır.
Belirli bir niteleme yapısı, yaşanan zaman kesitinin çetin olduğunu bildirir.

Belirli bir dişi hayvan nitelemesi, otlakta kendi başına uzaklaşan hayvanı gösterir.
Aynı hayvan nitelemesi, yavrusunu yırtıcının yiyebileceği biçimde gözetimsiz bırakan anayı da gösterir.
İnsan nitelemelerinde malını sürekli savuran ve ziyan eden kişi anlatılır.
